title: RoadGenParams
description: Validates FLRRoadGenParams: the GenParams object of RouteDefinition files, or the data object of a standalone RoadGenParams file.

InitialStraightLengthM.description: Length of the first straight (spawn area), meters.

MinArcLengthM.description: Minimum length of the constant-radius part of a curve, meters.

MaxArcLengthM.description: Maximum length of the constant-radius part of a curve, meters.

MinRadiusM.description: Minimum curve radius, meters (>= 1000 to be drivable at 300 km/h).

CurveProbability.description: Probability that a straight is followed by a curve.

TurnReversalProbability.description: Probability that a curve turns opposite to the previous one.

MaxArcHeadingChangeDeg.description: Maximum heading change of the constant-radius part, degrees.

TransitionLengthM.description: Easement length at each end of a curve, meters (0 = none).

GradeChangeProbability.description: Probability that a piece changes the grade.
